competitors.raw_snapshot: Tier1/Tier2均403，转WebSearch。本轮PH榜单命中：Aymo AI(全模型聚合workspace)、Nautis(创始人AI OS)、Alpine(docs+tasks+chat)、Drawsy(canvas+code)、illumi(可视化workspace)，以及'Liminal: A workspace & 2nd brain for you, your agent, and your team'——描述为'agents write files locally in markdown and HTML, which Liminal renders as clean UI instantly and syncs to your team in real time...share a link and everyone sees the same live workspace, editable in the browser...their edits land back on your disk instantly...Multiple agents can read and write into the same workspace'。命中watch_keywords：agent/workspace/live/collaboration/canvas，≥2命中，记录为new_entrant。其余产品未见与meee2高度重叠。
competitors.content_hash: Tier1/Tier2均403，转WebSearch。本轮PH榜单命中：Aymo AI、Nautis、Alpine、Drawsy、illumi，以及Liminal

changes.description: 新发现产品「Liminal」：agent本地写markdown/HTML文件，平台即时渲染为UI并与团队实时双向同步，分享链接即可让所有人在浏览器中编辑同一个live workspace，编辑会实时写回本地磁盘，支持多agent同时读写同一workspace
changes.evidence: 「agents write files locally in markdown and HTML, which Liminal renders as clean UI instantly and syncs to your team in real time...share a link and everyone sees the same live workspace, editable in the browser...their edits land back on your disk instantly」
changes.meee2_relevance: 推断：本地文件与云端UI的双向实时同步('their edits land back on your disk instantly')直接触碰锚点2（跨工具artifact live link，非snapshot）；agent写文件、平台从真实文件emerge出UI渲染，触碰锚点3（descriptive-first）；多agent读写同一workspace，触碰锚点1的部分结构（同一协议下多方协作）。三项锚点同时触碰，结构重叠度高，建议下次监控周期将其加入sources.json独立跟踪并评估threat等级

key_findings: 新品「Liminal」（本地文件↔云端UI实时双向同步workspace，多agent协作）与meee2锚点2/3高度重叠，建议纳入独立跟踪
本轮PH其余上新（Aymo AI/Nautis/Alpine/Drawsy/illumi）均为通用AI workspace聚合类产品，无深度结构重叠
